Examples accompanying *Estimating Nonlinear Heterogeneous Agent Models with Neural Networks*
by Hanno Kase, Leonardo Melosi, and Matthias Rottner.

Learn how to solve and estimate macroeconomic models with neural networks, starting with
a small New Keynesian model, where each extension introduces one change at a time, and
moving on to progressively more complex models.

Start with the [overview](overview.qmd). It explains the method step by step,
shows how the examples are organized, and sets up the Python environment.

## Examples

- [New Keynesian model](rank/index.qmd), with ten extensions
- [One-asset HANK](hankmp/index.qmd)
- Krusell–Smith with [one asset](ks/one-asset.qmd) and [two assets](ks/two-asset.qmd)

Every example ships its trained networks and saved results, so the code can reproduce the
figures without retraining.
